I answered Hollis in a thread on his message. The ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is PD-4821.

He posted it himself in #central-team on 9 Jun. That's the ticket where the import file labels the doors E1/E2 but their booking sheet uses 01/02. He's in #central-team, so I only used a channel he can already read.
